operational-example.copy: Use Card Expiry Input to capture one MM/YY card expiry with numeric keyboard, cc-exp autocomplete, local month and expired-date validation, and recovery copy before a pattern or template handles card enrollment.

scenario.title: Driver card expiry

items.label: Expiry date
items.helper: Use the expiry printed on the card.

rationale: It formats and validates one card expiry without owning enrollment.
It keeps MM/YY, helper, error, autocomplete, and numeric keyboard together as one component.
Use a pattern later for card number, CVV, backend validation, tokenization, and card ownership.

items.rule: Names the expiry field and remains visible.
Uses Input rhythm, focus, density, and mono value styling.
Signals date capture without replacing label or helper text.
Formats digits as MM/YY while preserving raw digits for callbacks.
Uses month and expired-date checks only for local recovery.

accessibility.statePrecedence: disabled, loading, error, valid, filled, default
items: Associate visible label and helper or error text with the input.
Use inputmode numeric and autocomplete cc-exp.
Expose invalid month or expired date with aria-invalid only when recovery is required.
Do not announce or display backend approval or card ownership from this component.
Preserve keyboard entry, paste, autofill, and correction.

variants.copy: Card Expiry Input variants describe local expiry capture treatment. Card number, security code, and full card enrollment remain separate components or future patterns.

states.copy: States communicate entry, local validation, loading, error, and disabled behavior without owning card enrollment.

variant-state-behavior.copy: Card Expiry Input has one local capture variant; state tells whether the value is empty, incomplete, valid, loading, invalid, expired, or unavailable.

full-width.copy: Card Expiry Input fills onboarding and wallet forms while preserving compact MM/YY rhythm.

responsive-layout-patterns.copy: Keep the compact expiry visible and correctable. Multi-field card enrollment should wait until Card Number, Expiry, and Security Code components are all ready.

viewport-organization.copy: Card Expiry Input remains a single field component; viewport rules decide density and pairing with sibling card fields.

items.title: Phone
items.rule: Use large density and keep helper copy close to the field.

items.title: Tablet
items.rule: Pair beside security code only when touch targets remain clear.

items.title: Desktop
items.rule: Use standard density in admin or support forms.

playground.copy: Use the playground to verify MM/YY formatting, month and expired-date state, helper copy, density, and disabled/loading behavior before composing card enrollment screens.

api-foundations.copy: Card Expiry Input API exposes one local expiry field. It owns MM/YY formatting and local month or expired-date validation only; backend validation, tokenization, card ownership, CVC, card number, and submission stay outside the component.

props.name: error
props.notes: Visible recovery message; overrides local expiry message.

props.name: loading
props.notes: Shows a check in progress without claiming approval.

props.name: onValueChange
props.notes: Called with formatted value, raw digits, month, year, validity, and expired flag.

groups.title: Use
items: Use for one card expiry date.
Use local validation only for month and expiration.
Keep helper and error copy direct.

groups.title: Avoid
items: Do not own card number, CVC, or full card form behavior.
Do not hide expired-state recovery in placeholder copy.

groups.title: Review
items: Check card program rules before backend submission.
Check expired-date copy against the product policy.

mustTest: MM/YY formatting on input and paste
Valid, invalid month, expired, incomplete, and empty states
rejectIf: The component owns backend validation, tokenization, card ownership, or submission.
Expired or invalid state is color-only.
The value is not formatted or cannot be corrected.
Autocomplete and numeric input mode are missing.

miel.copy: MIEL treats Card Expiry Input as one sensitive supporting field. Agents may place it for expiry capture, but humans confirm card program, expired-date policy, and surrounding enrollment system.
canDecide: Use Card Expiry Input for one MM/YY expiry.
Use local month and expired-date validation.
Use loading only for a local or backend check in progress.
mustAsk: The system stores, tokenizes, validates with backend, or associates a card.
The card program has nonstandard expiry rules.
Card number, CVC, brand selection, or payment ownership is required.
rejectIf: The component owns the full card form.
The component promises payment or ownership approval.
Expired-date behavior is hidden in helper copy.
miel.handoff: I am using Card Expiry Input for one MM/YY expiry with local month and expired-date validation. Please confirm the card program, backend validation path, recovery copy, and whether Card Number or Security Code components are also needed.
